messages.subject: DeployApp used wrong app name
parts:
For some reason when I deployed a recent app it automatically used the name of a previous app even though the current directory did not match the previous app's directory name.  I was able to correct the problem by deploying the app specifying the name explicitly with the option appName however I think there is a bug somewhere.

Thanks,
Francis
